mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult model with at least three identity anchors and one original material motif. Move through at least four different accessory classes. In each module, show one tactile operation or structural proof before allowing the same highlight, texture, edge geometry or sound to match into the next object. After the detail ladder, reconnect all objects to the same adult's full-body posture and gait. End on one completely original short brand name with no source marks or product silhouettes. The reusable mechanism is tactile accessory evidence, material-motif relay, scale expansion, full-body reconnection and original identity closure—not the source model, luxury brand, monogram, product designs, white set, exact shots, creator identity or timing.

invariants.purpose: Shows how objects form one look.
